The user approved the A1+ Unit 2 plan on 2026-11-19 (A1+ 2.Y follows A1 2.Y, one grammar step each) and chose "Straight to Preview": no per-lesson gates, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, reviewed in Preview. Batch C (2.11-2.15) was started on 2026-11-20 on the user's "Start Batch C when Preview is done". Three pairs of photos differ only in light or dark: Ana holds a light blue and then a dark blue bag, Diego wears a light green and then a dark green shirt, and Luis has a light brown and then a dark brown dog. The dark photo is a Gemini edit of the light one that changes only the color. Learn plays each pair as two lines over their own photos. Banks keep the sentence and change only light or dark; picture cards set the light photo against the dark one.

lesson.title: 2.13 Light blue, dark blue
lesson.unit_title: Places, things and how we describe them
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people go and how they get there, talk about the things people have, point things out and compare them, put things in order, and ask about favorites.
lesson.goal: Say whether a color is light or dark (My bag is light blue. / The dog is dark brown. / It's dark green.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 2.13 More Colors: A1 adds brown, pink, purple and gray; A1+ 2.13 puts light or dark before a color (light blue, dark blue). Each scene has two photos that differ only in that one color, made as an edit of the first: Ana's bag, Diego's shirt and Luis's dog, light and then dark. It brings back A1+ 2.4's It's (What color is your bag? It's light blue.) and 2.8's favorite (Diego: My favorite color is dark green.).
lesson.prerequisite: A1 2.8 and 2.13 colors; A1 What color is it?; A1+ 2.4 It's; A1+ 2.8 favorite; A1 bag, shirt, dog; A1 has.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say light with a clear l and dark with a long a (LIGHT blue, DARK blue). Do not require native-like speed.
